caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with an angular, hexagonal shape and a high, curved hood on one end. The cradle is composed of brown wood with visible grain patterns and has two handles cut into the side panels. It stands on two curved rockers, also made from wood, allowing it to rock back and forth. Inside the cradle, there is a light-colored mattress or quilt with a subtle pattern and a white pillow with hints of pink and purple shading. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or decor visible. The cradle is positioned at a slight angle, with the hooded end at the back right of the image.
title: Cradle
